IF OBJECT_ID('Sales.GetRecentFeedbackByRegion', 'P') IS NOT NULL DROP PROCEDURE Sales.GetRecentFeedbackByRegion;
EXEC (' CREATE PROCEDURE Sales.GetRecentFeedbackByRegion AS BEGIN SELECT TOP 10 c.CustomerID, c.TerritoryID, f.Rating, f.FeedbackText, f.SubmittedAt, f.Status FROM Sales.Customer c JOIN Sales.CustomerFeedback f ON c.CustomerID = f.CustomerID WHERE f.SubmittedAt > DATEADD(day, -30, GETUTCDATE()) ORDER BY f.SubmittedAt DESC; END ');
